note: Assertions are referenced by (subject_node_id, assertion_type, assertion_key) rather than id, because seed assertion ids are generated at load time and must not be pinned.

questions.question: Tell me about Northwind Trading Co.
questions.notes: Floor case. If this misses, something is wrong with the harness, not with retrieval.

questions.question: Which customer is NW-4471?
questions.notes: External identity should rank above every fuzzy match.

questions.question: What do we buy from Coastal Steal Supply?
questions.notes: Typo-class miss. Fixable by threshold, not by embeddings.

questions.question: What is Meridian Fencing?
questions.notes: Two plausible entities. The right answer is to surface both, not to pick one.

questions.question: What does Harbor Point Marine Services handle?
questions.notes: Label is 'HPF Marine Services'. No trigram threshold reaches this from the expanded name. Fixable by vocabulary visibility (see issue #17) or by embeddings — this question is what tells those two apart.

questions.question: Who is the fence company we work with?
questions.notes: Reachable by reformulating to 'Meridian Fence'. Whether the agent gets there is the core measurement for the semantic-index decision.

questions.question: Why did the Pier 9 Rebuild slip?
questions.notes: Two causal hops upstream from the project.

questions.question: Did Coastal Steel Supply end up costing us the late delivery penalty?

forbidden_evidence.reason: A `regarding` edge connects these two directly. Citing it presents co-occurrence as causation — the exact failure the semantics filter exists to prevent.

questions.notes: The full 3-hop chain is the right answer. A 1-hop answer means the decoy was used.

questions.question: Did Meridian Fence & Gate cause the Pier 9 delay?

forbidden_evidence.reason: Only a `regarding` edge exists. The correct answer is no, and citing that edge as support is the error.

questions.notes: A correct negative. Agents that treat any path as evidence will answer yes.

questions.question: What is the current status of Pier 9 Rebuild?
questions.notes: Baseline: one hop, one assertion, one citation.

questions.question: What work does Meridian Fence & Gate do for us?
questions.notes: Same target as the paraphrase question, reached by name. Comparing the two isolates entry-point difficulty from answer difficulty.

questions.question: What is the most common cause of our project delays?
questions.notes: Coastal Steel Supply is upstream of two of three delayed projects. Rye has no aggregation surface today, so a failure here is the evidence for cohort digests — and a pass means the agent assembled it from per-subject traversal, which is worth knowing too.

questions.question: Is any one supplier behind more than one of our delayed projects?
questions.notes: Same shape, narrower phrasing. If this passes and q-crosssubject-01 fails, the gap is phrasing, not aggregation.

questions.question: What are Meridian Fence & Gate's payment terms?
questions.notes: The entity exists and is easy to find; the fact does not exist. Finding the node and then answering anyway is the failure mode.

questions.question: Who is the site safety officer on the Dock 4 Refit?
questions.notes: A plausible role that no assertion or edge establishes. Neighboring people exist, which is the temptation.

questions.question: How much did the late delivery penalty cost us?
questions.notes: The node is named for a cost that is never quantified anywhere. The hardest refusal in the set.
